features.name: log_income
features.description: Log-transformed income to handle extreme skewness and provide a smoother feature space for linear margins.
features.expected_model_benefit: Reduces the impact of extreme outliers in transaction values, allowing the linear SVM to learn more stable weights.

features.name: log_count
features.description: Log-transformed transaction count to compress the wide range of transaction volumes.
features.expected_model_benefit: Linearizes the relationship between transaction volume and the decision boundary.

features.name: log_looped
features.description: Log-transformed looped transaction count to normalize the distribution of cyclic transaction behaviors.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a continuous, well-scaled measure of cyclic behavior suitable for linear models.

features.name: log_neighbors
features.description: Log-transformed neighbor count to handle the heavy-tailed distribution of network connectivity.
features.expected_model_benefit: Prevents highly connected nodes from dominating the linear SVM margin.

features.name: loop_to_count_ratio
features.description: Ratio of looped transactions to total transactions, clipped to a maximum of 10 for stability.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures the relative frequency of cyclic behavior, which is often a strong structural signal independent of total volume.

features.name: weight_per_length
features.description: Average weight per unit of transaction length.
features.expected_model_benefit: Normalizes transaction weight by its path length, providing a density metric useful for linear separation.

features.name: log_income_per_neighbor
features.description: Log-transformed ratio of income to the number of neighbors.
features.expected_model_benefit: Highlights nodes that receive disproportionately large amounts of income relative to their network degree.

features.name: network_density_proxy
features.description: Ratio of neighbors to total transaction count, clipped for stability.
features.expected_model_benefit: Measures the breadth of the network relative to activity volume, providing a structural feature for the SVM.

features.name: mid_year_proximity
features.description: Absolute normalized distance from the middle of the year (day 182.5).
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures potential seasonality or temporal clustering in a continuous format suitable for linear models.

features.name: sqrt_weight
features.description: Square root of the transaction weight to reduce skewness while preserving zero values.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a milder transformation than log for the weight feature, balancing the distribution for linear margins.

features.name: semantic_transaction_complexity
features.description: A semantic assessment of the overall complexity of the transaction pattern, considering the interplay between length, weight, count, and looped values.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a holistic, non-linear interpretation of transaction complexity that a linear SVM cannot easily construct from raw features.

features.name: semantic_anomalous_topology_score
features.description: An expert-level judgment score evaluating the anomaly level of the network topology based on the relationship between neighbors, income, and cyclic loops.
features.expected_model_benefit: Injects domain-specific structural anomaly detection into the feature space, enhancing the linear model's ability to separate complex patterns.
